model_details.name: UFNS Multi-City Urban Flood Extent & Depth Nowcaster
model_details.framework: UFNS Native Python/NumPy (Zero External Heavy Dependencies, CPU Optimized)

intended_use.primary_use: Real-time 0-3 hour urban flood depth and road impassability prediction for emergency dispatch and civic alerts.
intended_use.users: Disaster Management Authorities (DDMA/BDMA/MCGM), Emergency Responders, Citizens
intended_use.out_of_scope: Coastal storm surge wave modeling without inland precipitation, or long-term climate projections beyond 6 hours.

training_data.temporal_split_rationale: Strict temporal sequence prevents temporal data leakage across sequential storm overpasses.

data_provenance_summary.rainfall: IMD High-Resolution Gridded & AWS 15-min / CHIRPS v3.0-p05
data_provenance_summary.ground_truth_extent: Sentinel-1 SAR GRD Level-1 Dual-Pol 10m Water Extent

limitations_and_caveats: Conduit flow calculations assume clean drainage unless manual choke factor is set.
Subterranean municipal drainage is marked as SIMULATED/UNAVAILABLE if authoritative GIS is missing.
Predictions are updated continuously on fresh rainfall observations without mutating training weights.
